property_summary: For every call to initialize the reference contract reverts (does not allow initialization) when feeRate > 5000, i.e. initialize succeeds only when feeRate <= 5000; the mutant removes that check and therefore allows initialize to succeed for some feeRate > 5000.
change_summary: Remove the check that reverts when _feeRate > 5000, allowing larger feeRate values to be set during initialization.
